comments.text: Somaliland is especially interesting because understanding it requires separating geography, culture and everyday life from the complicated political question of recognition. 🌍 The rock art of Laas Geel, Berbera’s maritime history, camel culture and strong oral traditions reveal a region with a much deeper identity than its limited presence in international coverage suggests. It’s exactly the kind of place where travel can complicate the simple picture we get from maps.
